reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Sun Serum 50ml Set (+7ml)
reviews.text: I loved the OG round lab sunscreen as always i finished at least 3-4 tubes of that so I thought of trying other sunscreens from the same brand. This pink collagen version is a lot more moisturizing, suitable for drier skin types and forms a good base before applying foundations!
reviews.zh: 我一向都好鍾意 round lab 嗰支經典防曬，我已經用完至少 3-4 支，所以想試吓同一個品牌嘅其他防曬。呢款粉紅 collagen 版本保濕好多，啱返乾性肌用，而且做妝前打底超好！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Sun Serum 50ml Set (+7ml)
reviews.text: I’m in my 30s and have tried so many JP, KR, and US sunscreens… and I finally found my holy grail!  No strong sunscreen smell, super lightweight, and just the right amount of moisture for that real dewy glow (not greasy or oily). It actually makes my skin look and feel better both on and after I take it off—like I’m just putting on a nice moisturizer. If you hate wearing sunscreen because it breaks you out or whatever reason, give this one a try! Now I just need it to never get discontinued!
reviews.zh: 我三十幾歲，試過勁多日韓美嘅防曬⋯⋯終於俾我搵到命定嘅防曬！冇好重嘅防曬味，超輕身，保濕度啱啱好，做到真正嘅水光感（唔會油笠笠）。無論搽緊定係抺走之後，皮膚都望落摸落都好好——就好似淨係搽咗一支好保濕嘅面霜咁。如果你因為怕爆瘡或者其他原因唔想搽防曬，真係要試吓呢支！而家淨係希望佢永遠都唔好停產！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Sun Serum 50ml Set (+7ml)
reviews.text: If I could use one sunscreen forever this would be it. I love the fact that it's a serum and not a heavy cream or gel. absolves fast, leaves no white cast whatsoever and my skin looks refreshed healthy and most importantly protected. Other brands take notes, this is a must buy and will definitely be repurchasing.
reviews.zh: 如果我可以用一支防曬用到永遠，一定係呢支。我鍾意佢係精華質地，唔係厚重嘅霜或 gel。吸收得好快，完全唔會泛白，皮膚望落精神、健康，最緊要係有足夠防護。其他品牌要留意啦，呢支係必買，一定會回購。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Sun Serum 50ml Set (+7ml)
reviews.text: This is the perfect sunscreen for wearing underneath makeup because it leaves such a smooth and soft base after applying. The texture is more like a serum and isn’t as thick and pasty like normal sunscreens. I wear it both alone and underneath makeup. I also have the dokdo sunscreen and alternate between this one and the dokdo if I’m not wearing makeup.
reviews.zh: 呢支防曬簡直係為咗化妝打底而設，搽完之後皮膚滑滑軟軟。質地比較似精華，唔似一般防曬咁厚同漿。我會單獨用，又會喺妝前用。我仲有 dokdo 嗰支防曬，唔化妝嗰陣就兩支輪住用。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Sun Serum 50ml Set (+7ml)
reviews.text: I like how good spreads on the skin, fast absorption, no sticky effect, no white cast, no perfume. My skin looks also nourished and hydrated. I feel it really protected me against the sun, made a good job in this summer holiday.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意佢喺皮膚上面好易推開，吸收得快，唔會黐立立，唔會泛白，冇香料。皮膚望落都更滋潤保濕。覺得佢真係幫到我抵擋太陽，暑假嗰陣表現好好。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Sun Serum 50ml Set (+7ml)
reviews.text: I love all Round Lab sunscreens, so of course I wanted to try the new Camellia one. The texture is super light, almost like a serum. Sometimes I feel a slight tingling when I apply it, probably when my skin is a bit sensitized or irritated.
reviews.zh: Round Lab 嘅防曬我全部都鍾意，所以當然想試吓新出嘅 Camellia 版本。質地超輕，幾乎似精華。有時搽嘅時候會有少少刺刺嘅感覺，可能係皮膚比較敏感或者受刺激嘅時候。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Sun Serum 50ml Set (+7ml)
reviews.text: Saw an influencer praise this product and recommend to use it as a base before makeup and absolutely love it!! It has a more watery application so it won’t pill like other sunscreens when you apply makeup on top of it. The pink undertone also helps to brighten your skin. If you love Round Lab’s sunscreens then you’ll like this one even more because it’s super lightweight and refreshing. Highly recommend this as a base before makeup or if you like to layer up on sunscreens!
reviews.zh: 睇到有 influencer 讚呢個產品，話可以喺妝前用做打底，我就即刻試，結果勁鍾意！！佢質地比較水感，所以化妝時唔會好似其他防曬咁搓出泥。粉紅底調仲可以幫助提亮膚色。如果你鍾意 Round Lab 嘅防曬，你就會更加鍾意呢支，因為超輕又超清爽。強烈推薦用嚟做妝前打底，或者鍾意疊加防曬嘅人都啱用！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Sun Serum 50ml Set (+7ml)
reviews.text: Personally, it gave slight irritation with every use. Not enough to bother me the whole day, but during application. Did take a bit of time and massaging for it to settle on my skin. Felt lightweight throughout the day.
reviews.zh: 對我嚟講，每次用都會有少少刺激。唔至於成日都困擾我，但搽嘅時候真係有。要花少少時間按摩，皮膚先吸收到。成日用住感覺都幾輕身。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
